Instruct 모델 결과를 담은 이 그림에서' -> one sentence; pipeline meta-notes in prose: L519 '수치는 여기서 다루는 자료에 없어, 격차를 %나 %p로 적을 수는 없습니다', L551 '구체적 값은 여기서 다루는 자료에 없습니다', L605/L619 '상대값인지 %p인지는 원문에서 구분되지 않습니다'; formulaic L86 '눈여겨볼 시연은 다음과 같습니다.'; noun frame L113 '피드백 루프로 바뀌었다는 점이 중요합니다' -> '피드백 루프로 바뀐 것이 핵심입니다'; repeated disclaimer '이는 이 글의 가상 예시입니다/이 경우도 가상 예시입니다' (L379, L397, L409, L427, L343).
score_notes.C: Lineage-to-lineage transitions are good (L165 Jailbroken->GCG, L191 GCG->PAIR, L213 GCG->SmoothLLM, L271, L423, L499, L523). Deductions: internal contradictions with the table: L519 says SecAlign's ASR values are not available, yet L708 gives 'ASR 1% / 8%'; L551 says per-defense values are not available, yet L713 gives 'tool filter 8'; L605 says knowing names 'did not change ASR much' while L679 says writing the names '성공률을 좌우하는 셈'; false table cross-references (L673, L677, L685, L691 '표에서 ... 비슷해 보이는 행도 있습니다' with no utility column); the same point restated many times (StruQ partial vs GCG: L477, L557, L655, L677, L683; CaMeL utility rising with Claude generation: L551, L689, L734).
score_notes.D: Help where it is hard: GCG one-hot gradient and candidate sampling (L173), PoisonedRAG retrieval/generation conditions (L249), AgentPoison uniqueness/compactness losses (L293-305), SecAlign loss at initialisation log 2 worked example (L507), CaMeL provenance walk-through on the assistant (L539). Over-padding: the email-assistant mapping is appended to nearly every subsection (L70, L103, L145, L227, L271, L323, L465, L489, L529, L575, L591, L631, L653, L667, L724, L728); MCP re-glossed at L337 after L15; figures introduced with a reading instruction but no content (L209 '한눈에 볼 수 있습니다', L349-353, L363-367, L591).
score_notes.E: 47 source figures, all referred to descriptively; timeline and comparison tables; equations for each core mechanism (L121-131, L167, L215, L245-255, L285-303, L375, L501). Deductions: several figures carry no read-out of what they show (Prompt Infection L351, L365; MCP L413; InjecAgent L587); comparison table mixes units and raw labels: L703 'ASR 3.8' (no unit), L712 '0.05→0.87' (ratio while other rows use %), L698 'combination_3 GPT-4 0.94' (code identifier, ratio), L714 'DACC', 'FPR', L696 '정량 수치 없음' as a result cell; no setting column, so dataset/variant is squeezed into cells unevenly.
score_notes.F: 13 of 15 sampled claims supported; 1 wrong (L519: the paper does report the numbers it says are absent), 1 unsupported variant (L705 BadAgent 100% is QLoRA only; AdaLoRA OS ASR is 85.0). Outside the sample: L551 makes the same false 'values not in the material' claim (CaMeL text: 'the number of successful attacks with CaMeL is 0, while ... tool filter is 8'); L715 limitation 'Cline 단일 클라이언트 고정' drops the paper's scope (only Benchmark 1 fixes Cline; Benchmark 2 compares five clients, which L417 itself discusses); L712 '0.05→0.87' is a mean across defenses without saying so.
score_notes.S1: Limitation cells that are results, not limitations: L716 ToolHijacker 'gradient-based 섀도 LLM 의존성(최저 34%)' (a sensitivity result; the paper's scope is the no-box attack with no new defense); L715 MCP 'Cline 단일 클라이언트 고정' over-narrows; L699 GCG '과적합으로 인한 전이성 저하' is an observation from a figure (Fig. 6 caption 'showing signs of potential overfitting'), not a stated limitation. Cells use English labels (DACC, FPR, AHR in body, 'gradient-based'). Synthesis sections mostly compare lineages rather than restating cards, but L683/L689 re-run StruQ/SecAlign/CaMeL cards.

claim_headings.evidence: H2s are claim noun phrases ('## 명령 없이 지식만 심는 RAG·메모리 오염' L229, '## 필터에서 설계 기반 보장으로 옮겨 간 인젝션 방어' L453); H3s are 'Name: claim' ('### CaMeL: 모델이 속아도 흐름은 격리하는 설계' L521).

running_example.evidence: The email assistant with three entry paths (L15, L19) recurs in every lineage (L70, L233, L343, L455, L575, L649, L673, L748).

mechanism_design_formula_example.evidence: SecAlign: SFT vs preference design (L499) -> DPO loss (L501) -> log 2 worked example (L507); CaMeL: Dual LLM gap (L531) -> P/Q-LLM + capabilities (L537) -> walk-through (L539); PoisonedRAG: objective (L245) -> two conditions (L249) -> S/I construction (L251-257).

facts_said_once.evidence: L577 and L583 define the same two metrics back to back; StruQ partial vs GCG stated five times (L477, L557, L655, L677, L683); CaMeL utility rising with Claude generations three times (L551, L689, L734); BERT detector false positives twice (L613, L685); PromptInject 58.6%/23.6% in body L68 and table L695; PoisonedRAG 0.97 in L259 and table L702.

numbers_with_scope.evidence: Most numbers carry model/setting (L175 'Vicuna-7B 88%, Llama-2-7B-Chat 57%', L225 'PIQA에서 q=5, N=20'); gaps: L705 BadAgent 100% without QLoRA, L703 'ASR 3.8' no unit, L712 mean over defenses unstated, L715 Cline scope.

nothing_invented.evidence: Writer's examples are labelled (L343 '이는 이 글의 가상 설정입니다', L507 '가상의 수치로'); but L519 and L551 state the source lacks numbers the papers give (SecAlign 1%/8%, CaMeL 0 vs 8).

writer_assessment_at_end.evidence: L736 '모델 교체를 보안 개선으로 간주해서는 안 됩니다', L750 '주입이 성공해도 파일이 밖으로 나갈 수 있는가', plus L561, L645, L691 judgments marked '이 글의 판단으로는'.

length_fitted_to_difficulty.evidence: About 27.8k Hangul characters and 47 figures for 24 papers; hard mechanisms get room, but email-assistant restatements, figure reading-instructions without content and repeated points add length without content.

type_specific_shape.evidence: Survey shape (timeline, lineages, cross-lineage, comparison, synthesis, close) is present; but numbers are not owned by the comparison table: the body carries most result numbers (L68, L175, L259, L313, L385, L475-477, L545, L637) and the table repeats some.
